dissent: Control-build's restart-chain rule (:116) is sound given endpoint uniqueness plus live-pairing; no defect found there.
Reporting unreachable-witness controls as 'unwitnessed' rather than detected is honest, not a defect.
findings: Implement under-verifies pair causal indices: _audit_event (~o24-incarnation-pairs-implement.py:215-217) requires only int type and pair[key]<=i for source_event/target_event, never ==i nor mutual equality. Original binds si=qi=event index (semantic.py:41 via check.py audit_case advance(...,i,i)) and demands exact whole-ledger equality. Fixture: supported case, set incarnation_pairs[0] source_event=target_event=0 though bound at event 7 -> still 'supported' (endpoints/reason match sim[-1]; digests computed over sim). Control-build rejects via :108-117. Fix: require source_event==target_event==i on 'new-binding'.

Staged-disjunct evidence is not recomputed and identity proofs are weakly or not verified. Implement _audit_prefix (:264-274) derives staged_rule from retained differing-field lists (self-authenticating) and only requires truthy identity_proof. Control-build (:131-142) checks case/prefix/ei<i/stage verb/stage:ok/state+source_prefix digests but skips adapter_prefix_sha256, origin before/after digests, and any recompute that 'staged' actually differs. Both accept staged_rule='strict' with identity_proof=None at an identity-applicable prefix. Originals recompute differing fields and full proof (adapter_traces.py:19-22; identity_audit.py expected_proof/check). Fix: recompute 'staged' membership from restored ss[i]/aa[i]; verify all proof fields.

Control-build binder semantics incomplete, so extra or content-free pairs pass: per-pair require (:106-117) checks verb/decisions/new-binding only; endpoints are never compared to restored ss[e+1]/aa[e+1] generations, attestation-input equality ('different-attestation-input', BINDINGS :25, semantic.py:48) is unreachable, and ordering (:120) is merely nondecreasing so two pairs may share one source_event though advance binds once per event. Fixture: real attestation pair plus fabricated token pair at same source_event with consistent ledger digests -> accepted; implement rejects via consumed!=len(retained) (:279-281). Fix: simulate bind per event or require distinct source_events and endpoint equality to restored generations.

Checker/controls interop misclassifies detections: run_controls scores detection only when status=='counterexample' (:184-188). Wired to implement's inspect_cases, hash/patch/structure corruptions surface as gaps -> 'unproved' (restore :142-188, _audit_case :320-325, status :379-382); absent 'prefixes' also yields unproved-gap (:312-319,:367-368) where control-build hard-requires them (:103-104); clean zero-binding evidence returns 'unproved' (:383-385) where 'unaltered-retained-evidence' demands 'supported'. E.g. 'erased-q-invocation-record' reports undetected under implement despite being flagged. Fix: count counterexample-or-gapped-unproved as detected and align status vocabulary.
limitations: Static source review only; no execution performed or claimed.
responses_related, differing_* and journal-field claims stay unverified in both; arguably outside the o24 obligation but weakens certificate integrity.

Control-build's 'counter'/'ceiling' message-sniff re-raise (:154-156) can misclassify budget exhaustion; implement converts original hard binder failures into matchable labels 'typed-pair-violation'/'advancement-violation' (:114,:136) absent from control-build's BINDINGS.
summary: NEEDS_CORRECTION. Both o24 artifacts are present (implement=checker; control-build=checker plus run_controls) and genuinely complementary: implement replays an independent bind simulation while control-build verifies authoring-event causality. Each accepts forged retained evidence on a different axis, neither recomputes the compared-field relation behind staged_rule, and the control harness misclassifies the implement checker's gap-style detections. Per-prefix and per-repetition precharge exists in both (control-build ~:122; implement ~:328-333).
